limits: No model or provider was called.
Stipulated authorization, status, time, references and lineage are inputs; there is no natural-language history extractor or event reducer.
Grant status is resolved once at the fixture clock; no mid-trace revocation is modeled.
The evaluator consumes the first allowed witness; it is not a complete planner for overlapping grants or alternative resource assignments.
Policy variants are authored ablations, not implementations attributed to existing products.
Cases and exhaustive probes are correlated constructions, not independent empirical validation.

cases.rationale: A currently operative user grant covers the entire action tuple.
A valid standing grant is not extinguished merely because it was issued in an earlier turn.
The user acceptance supplies authority; the assistant proposal supplies the bounded semantic operand.
A proposal can specify a plan without authorizing it.
An acceptance issued by a stipulated actor without the relevant authority creates no grant.
The authoritative acceptance has no recoverable proposal referent.
The supplied acceptance reference is stipulated ambiguous; a shared goal does not resolve that ambiguity.
An acceptance of version 1 continues to cover its bounded action although a later unaccepted version exists.
A later proposal sharing the goal is not thereby accepted.
The fixture content identity disagrees with the accepted reference; this fixture does not infer which content was intended.
A previously genuine grant is currently revoked.
The stipulated expiry precedes the fixture clock.
The validity interval is half open: now equal to valid_until is expired.
The stipulated grant has not yet entered its validity interval.
The grant is active within its validity interval.
A retained complete action tuple remains inside the descendant restriction.
A parent permission is absent from the current descendant restriction.
All four values occur in true grants, but the recombined tuple has no authentic joint grant.
Either independent complete grant can witness an action; a global intersection would wrongly reject this second grant.
Each exact grant permits its action from the initial state; the common pool constrains the composed trace.
Each exact grant permits its action from the initial state; the common pool constrains the composed trace.
The publication grant validly permits the exact action when its input is independently public.
Both full action grants exist, but the derived private provenance makes the publication prefix impermissible.
An explicit current grant authorizes this precise cross-boundary release; inherited labels are retained.
An exception for a different artifact cannot bridge this trace.
An operative one-use grant allows its first covered action.
The exact tuple remains unchanged, but the one-use grant is exhausted after the first action.
The supplied authority capability is unresolved, so the diagnostic does not infer it from fluent memory.
A valid grant may refer to non-authoritative descriptive operands without turning those operands into authority roots.
A historical cross-boundary exception does not apply after its stipulated revocation.
This complete synthetic fixture contains no grant; missing evidence in an open real history would need separate treatment.
An explicit standing grant can authorize a bounded set of discretionary means without version-bound acceptance of every plan.

scope_probe.description: Complete 2x2x2x2 product of the marginals of two authentic full-scope grants.

budget_probe.description: All ordered cost pairs in {1,...,10}^2 under one authenticated shared cap of 10; both exact grants permit their step in a fresh state.
